result.title: Characterizing Cross-Relay Generalization Failure in Machine Learning-Based Power System Protection
result.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Accepted for presentation at the IEEE Power & Energy Student Summit (PESS 2026), Karlsruhe, Germany
result.summary: Machine learning-based fault detectors are often evaluated at the relay locations used for training, although local voltage and current measurements vary across power networks. This work investigates cross-relay generalization for binary detection of faults anywhere in the network using local measurements, rather than line-selective tripping. Using 50 ms windows from a simulated 110 kV transmission network, we evaluate a multilayer perceptron across all 64 source target combinations of eight relays and five random seeds. A shared simulation-level split and source-only threshold selection provide a controlled held-out evaluation without target-specific calibration. Despite nearly unchanged mean F1-scores (0.730 within-relay versus 0.734 cross-relay), the mean false-positive rate (FPR) increases from 0.088 to 0.341, while the mean false-negative rate decreases from 0.399 to 0.318. The change is strongly directional: models trained at Bus 2 relays yield a mean FPR of 0.670 at Bus 1 and Bus 3 relays, compared with 0.096 for cross-relay transfers within the same bus group. Linear probing indicates that learned representations retain coarse bus-group information, while exploratory class-conditional latent distribution analysis shows no consistent monotonic association with transfer errors. These findings demonstrate that aggregate metrics can conceal location-structured changes in false-alarm behavior, highlighting the importance of evaluating error types separately when assessing cross-relay generalization.

AI.brief_summary: 在 110 kV 仿真电网中用本地 50 ms 电压电流窗口训练 MLP 做全网故障二分类，遍历八个继电器位置的 64 组源—目标组合，考察跨位置泛化，并辅以线性探针和类条件 latent 分布分析。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按位置分解 FPR/FNR、用线性探针检验表示是否保留粗粒度结构信息、并检验 latent 分布与迁移误差关联的做法，可供核查 LVR 中内部状态内容保留与 latent 相似度—失败关系的评价思路，但属电力领域，迁移需自行判断。
